entries.title: Create title cap is 100 chars after trim; update has no cap
entries.summary: validateCreateInput rejects titles longer than 100 characters, measured after trim(). validateUpdateInput has no length cap, so PUT can set longer titles than create allows.

entries.title: Note create accepts an empty content string
entries.summary: validateCreateInput in src/utils/validation.ts accepts content equal to the empty string on create: it only checks typeof content === string.

entries.title: Note create accepts any number of tags
entries.summary: validateCreateInput in src/utils/validation.ts places no limit on the number of tags on create.

entries.title: validateUpdateInput trims the title it returns
entries.summary: validateUpdateInput in src/utils/validation.ts returns data.title as the trimmed title string.

demotions.note: At HEAD, validateUpdateInput in src/utils/validation.ts:69-70 rejects tags: [] with field 'tags' ('Tags must not be an empty array'), so update no longer accepts an empty tags array. The test 'rejects an empty tags array' passes.

At HEAD, src/utils/validation.ts:64-65 validateUpdateInput has an else-if that pushes a 'content' error when obj.content === ''. The new test 'rejects an empty content string' in tests/validation.test.ts passes. So update no longer accepts an empty content string, and the claim is false.

At HEAD, src/utils/validation.ts:21-22 rejects create titles whose trimmed length is over 100 ('Title must be at most 100 characters'), so the claim that there is no maximum-length check is false. The test 'rejects a 101-character title' passes.
